phase_a_orientation.summary: UserSyncService.sync(userId) is annotated @Transactional and performs up to five attempts. Each attempt fetches the profile via RemoteUserClient.fetchProfile(userId), then persists it with UserRepository.saveProfile(userId, profile), returning immediately after both succeed. Any Exception from either the remote fetch or repository save is silently swallowed and retried; after five failures the method returns without reporting failure. The remote client contract declares IOException, while the repository save contract declares no checked exception.
